newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas rises again as volumes continue high.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas rises again as volumes continue high.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures rallied for the third day this week, as 275 lots were traded in Wednesday's afternoon session.
Volumes increased and prices were mostly higher.

Ten deals were done in the five months between October and February. October, with 125 lots in four trades, was the busiest month, as it had been on Tuesday when 200 lots out of 310 were traded in that month.
October traded consistently higher over the day, with deals done between 10.925 pence a therm and 11.05 pence.
The last trade done was 0.15 pence up from the settlement level on Tuesday.
November showed the greatest rise, trading at 13.30 pence, up by 0.2 pence from Tuesday's settlement.
January and February had both opened lower before trading up as the market rose over the afternoon.
The last trade in January showed no change from the previous settlement, while February eventually traded 0.05 pence higher than its level on Tuesday evening.
Front month August was bid at 9.20 pence and offered at 9.65 pence when the contract closed at 1500 GMT.
The trades on Wednesday brought the total for the week to 1035 lots traded, or an average of 345 a day.
